WITH eligible_winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id
  FROM manager_award AS ma
  INNER JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '(blank or missing)') AS hand,
         COUNT(*) AS winner_count
  FROM eligible_winners AS ew
  INNER JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ew.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '(blank or missing)')
)
SELECT hand,
       winner_count,
       1.0 * winner_count / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM hand_counts
ORDER BY hand;
